topic: Corporate Rebels 1-60 · hiring for values over skills (5/6)

passage.text: The founder of Southwest Airlines, Herb Kelleher, once said that the business of business is people. Southwest hires employees based on their values, recognising that employees are the guardians of corporate culture. It is worth being strict in this area, because you can train people to fly planes and serve passengers, but you cannot change who they are. For this reason, the airline makes serious efforts to hire carefully and, within a six-month trial period, to redirect those who are not suited to their roles. A survey of employees showed that 75 percent saw their job as a calling, and 86 percent were proud to work for the airline.
